thread:
rachel: heads-up I opened a docs PR to move the heatmap example to the cost-attribution endpoint and rename the trace field to `trace_hex`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5122
omar: thanks — CI linkcheck failed, anchor `heatmap-legacy` 404. console slug changed after dashboard rollout.
lucy: current dashboard anchor is `cost-heat-attr-v3`. use `#/overview?anchor=cost-heat-attr-v3`. Also note our linkchecker dislikes raw querystrings; angle brackets help.
rachel: switching to angle-bracket URL and pushing a link-only commit. Also there was a leftover Python snippet using `trace_id`  I'll update.
omar: small fixes for snippets: python: ```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient(trace_hex="beefcafe")
``` JS: ```js
const normalize = s => s.replace(/[^a-f0-9]/gi,'');
new ConsoleClient({ trace_hex: normalize(raw) });
``` Rust: ```rust
let client = ConsoleClient::builder().trace_hex("beefcafe").build();
```
docs-lint: docs build failed: /docs/console/observability/heatmap.md line 60: anchor not found https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/#/overview?anchor=heatmap-legacy
lucy: switched to `<https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/#/overview?anchor=cost-heat-attr-v3>` and turned the link into a named reference to appease linkcheck. Pushed commit 4.
ops-bot: FYI heatmap legend color stops changed in UI in rollout 2026-03; screenshot will need updating.
rachel: marking screenshot: deferred in PR body and adding TODO in the migration guide to attach new legend when available.
omar: added a curl smoke test to the PR and a Windows quoting note: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/trace -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"trace_hex":"beefcafe","events":[]}'
``` Note: on Windows use single quotes in Git Bash or escape double quotes in PowerShell.
lucy: also added a JSONL/escaping note for the examples after a report of backslash stripping on some shells: "If you see malformed JSONL on Windows, try writing payloads to a file and using `--data-binary @file.json`."
docs-lint: re-run: linkcheck, lint, and snippet-tests passed for PR 5122.
rachel: great  I'll attach the screenshot when UX hands it off and merge after that. Thanks everyone for fast reviews. :pray:
